lead.event: OJK and IDX roll out capital market reform measures
lead.headline: OJK and IDX launch reforms as 81 HSC stocks are set to leave IHSG
lead.blurb: The October evaluation also revises LQ45, IDX30 and IDX80 constituents, with HSC stocks planned for exclusion from the IHSG calculation from 2 November. OJK and BEI are shifting supervision from unusual market activity announcements and suspensions to targeted investigations, including account restrictions or temporary halts, and expanding the HSC committee to nine members. The measures aim to strengthen market integrity, governance and stability amid efforts to restore confidence after MSCI raised the risk of downgrading Indonesia’s market classification. The evaluation runs until 29 January 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Impack Pratama raises its 2026 net profit target
earnings_guidance.headline: IMPC raises 2026 net profit target above Rp800 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Impack Pratama's January-September net profit reached Rp640.23 billion, up 37.5% year on year and already above its full-year 2025 profit of Rp620 billion. President Director Haryanto Tjiptodihardjo cited stronger domestic demand and operating efficiency, but said higher raw-material and logistics costs, rupiah weakness, rising interest rates and softer consumer purchasing power could pressure fourth-quarter gross margins.

earnings_guidance.event: Ancora Indonesia Resources reports nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: OKAS reports USD2.45 million profit for nine months
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ancora’s sales were USD121.48 million, nearly unchanged from USD121.58 million a year earlier, while gross profit fell to USD30.92 million from USD34.57 million. Operating profit rose to USD14.78 million from USD5.87 million as net other operating expenses declined to USD755,560 from USD14.51 million.

earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA reports 4.2% nine-month profit growth to Rp45.2 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: BCA’s loans grew 12.6% year on year to Rp1,063 trillion as of September 2026. The bank attributed profit growth to solid lending, particularly productive credit, which rose 17.2% to Rp831 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: Loans grew 12.6% year on year to Rp1,063 trillion as of September 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports 20.7% nine-month profit growth to Rp45.5 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri said ecosystem-based credit expansion, digital transactions and business productivity drove results. Bank-only loans rose 16% to Rp1,605.8 trillion, while third-party funds increased 17.7% to Rp1,750.2 trillion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BUVA confirms its ongoing rights issue to IDX
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BUVA confirms rights issue as majority shareholder commits to exercise 3.47 billion rights
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bukit Uluwatu Villa responded to IDX inquiries and submitted its prospectus on 6 October. Majority shareholder Nusantara Utama Investama will exercise 3.47 billion pre-emptive rights and transfer 284 million to Tata Tirta Datun. Proceeds are intended for expansion, development, renovation and debt repayment.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TOBA secures HPS Investment commitment for waste-management expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA secures up to S$555 million HPS commitment for waste expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: TBS will receive the investment in stages through newly issued preferred shares and other instruments in SBTH Asia Holdings, parent of its waste platform. The funds will support organic growth and acquisitions across Asia.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS begins its Rp500 billion share buyback program
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS begins Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia is using internal cash, with repurchases capped at 20% of paid-up capital and scheduled through 26 January 2027. Its pro forma capital adequacy ratio is projected to fall from 20.41% to 20.19%, though the bank said the buyback would not materially affect its capital position or operations.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia bonds to default
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia’s Rp400 billion bonds to default
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Fitch said the downgrade followed Pos Indonesia’s failure to pay a coupon originally due 28 September before its 14-working-day grace period ended. The company also missed an 8 October rental payment on its Rp1 trillion first-phase sukuk, which remains within its grace period.

deals_control.blurb: Andira Agro said Puncak Jaya Sejahtera bought 3.08 billion shares at Rp30 each for Rp92.56 billion. The shares came from Anugerah Perkasa Semesta and Central Energi Pratama.

deals_control.event: BUMI acquires Australia's Mount Margaret Mining
deals_control.headline: BUMI acquires Mount Margaret Mining for US$22.01 million
deals_control.blurb: The Australian miner holds approximately 13 million tons of ore averaging 0.78% copper and 0.24 grams per ton gold. Bumi Resources acquired all its shares on 23 October through subsidiary Bumi Resources Australia as part of its diversification beyond coal, though its financial contribution depends on feasibility studies.
